findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(B) The merchandiser grates within the open display cooler on the food island was observed to have the accumulation of dangling soil and dust. Discussed with PIC.  Ensure that the dangling soil and dust is removed to prevent soil accumulation and possible contamination. 

Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: At the start of the inspection, the hand sink was observed blocked by two busted cans. These cans were removed from this location and placed into the triple sink. Ensure the hand washing sink remains accessible at all times and is only used for hand washing. 
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The top of the oven is observed to have a sticker still on it from the manufacturer that is peeling and becoming crinkled with accumulating soils. Ensure this sticker is removed and the surface of the oven is cleaned and sanitized.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: The hand sink in the back room is observed to not be functioning. PIC has submitted a work order of high priority as a follow-up is being scheduled for Monday, March 4, 2024. Ensure repairs are made to make the hand sink functioning again. As a temporary solution, employees will use a designated basin of the triple sink as a temporary solution until the hand sink is repaired and functional.
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The white table next to the pizza ovens that has a spatula stored on it and is used as a surface for food prep is observed visibly soiled during today’s inspection. PIC has wiped down and sanitized the table during today’s inspection. Ensure the food prep areas are cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean to sight and touch. 
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11:The hot dogs in the walk-in cooler are observed to be stored in a visibly soiled container. These hot dogs are to be discarded and replaced with fresh hot dogs in a clean and sanitized container. Ensure food items stored in clean and sanitized containers.
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: There is an opened package of hot dogs in the walk-in cooler observed with a date well past the 7 day rule. These hot dogs are removed from service and will be replaced with a fresh pack with correct date marking.
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There is observed the gaskets of the double door freezer needing a deep clean where soil and mold have accumulated. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: The mop was observed stored in the basin of the mop bucket. The mop needs to be placed either in the top of the mop bucket or in another position that allows for the mop head to air dry.
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: No proof of Certified Food Manager certification for the employees present at the time of the inspection. It was discussed on the previous routine inspection that the person in charge at the time of the inspection must have this certification, and therfore, additional staff may need this training. Provide more employees with the CFM.
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment: Observed beef sticks and cheese in the open display cooler that were probed at internal temperatures from 45-70F. The air coming out of the holes in this cooler is 29F, however, it is not cooling the foods sufficiently to keep them at internal temperatures of 41F or below at this time. Thermometer sitting on the shelf read 50F. All items that were labeled "Keep Refrigerated" on the label and were out of temperature were logged on a supplemental sheet to document what was voluntarily discarded. Do not store foods on the top of this cooler until unit has been repaired and is holding properly at 41F or below. The sandwiches in the bottom of this cooler are 39-41F and were not affected.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) and (B)  (P) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food is not maintained at 41°F, or less. Reviewed cold holding requirements and discussed HACCP concept with employee and person in charge. Inadequately held food was discarded. Reference 3-501.16(A)(2) and (B).

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment: Open packages of Nashville hot and cheddarwurst in the walk in cooler were dated 11/12-11/18, chicken tenders, chicken patties and buffalo chicken patties in the walk in cooler were dated 11/14-11/20, and egg rolls, pancake sausage and pork hot dogs were not dated. It appears as though these may have not been dated when opened this week, and manager on duty dated them at the time of the inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17  (Pf) Food shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a food establishment and if the food is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the food shall be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded, when held at a temperature of 41 deg F or less for a maximum of 7 days (not exceeding a manufacturer's use-by date). Discussed applicable sections of 3-501.17 and reviewed HACCP concepts with person in charge. Food was discarded. Reference 3-501.17.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment: Boxes of buns are observed on the floor in the walk in cooler. Store foods at least 6" off the floor.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11  (C) Food stored in an unapproved location. Food shall be protected by contamination by storing it: 1) in a clean, dry location; 2) where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination; 3) at least 6 inches above the floor. Reference 3-305.11.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment: Buns drawers are observed with rust in the bottoms. Remove rust from bun drawers.
findings.citation_text: 4-101.19  (C) Nonfood-contact surfaces have rusted or are no longer easily cleanable. Replace with a corrosion-resistant, nonabsorbent and smooth material meeting National Sanitation Foundation/ANSI certification for use within a foodservice facility.  Reference 4-101.19.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: The following non-food contact surfaces are soiled: 1) the pizza oven drip pans with char accumulation, 2) the top of the ovens in the back with food debris, 3) the wire rack on top of the oven with food debris, 4) the wrapper holders under the tornado roller grill in the customer area with dust and food debris, 5) the covers on the edges of the sandwich open display cooler with dust accumulation. Clean these non-food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.
